landing.cta_text: Leave your website and an email address. We send you a confirmation link; as soon as you confirm, the free analysis is unlocked.
landing.faq1_a: Yes: one analysis per confirmed email address, no account needed. We only email you the verification link.
landing.faq2_a: Only the technical signals of the page you enter: Core Web Vitals, accessibility, headers, SEO. No personal data.
landing.faq3_a: Every recommendation is tied to a measured value (contrast, headers, axe violations). If the data is missing, there is no advice.
landing.faq4_a: Yes: core version, plugins and publicly known vulnerabilities. You'll find the details in the report.
landing.ghost_footer: Every score tied to its evidence
landing.hero_lede: We scan performance, accessibility, security and SEO. The AI tells you the most urgent thing, why it matters, and how to fix it. Every piece of advice is tied to the data behind it.
landing.how_intro: Enter the URL, verify your email, get the report. That's it.
landing.meta_description: SiteIQ scans the performance, accessibility, security and SEO of your website, and the AI tells you in plain English what to fix and why. Every piece of advice is tied to the data behind it.
landing.no_personal_data: No personal data: we only email you the verification link.
